rule:
A pair (card -> target) is a pool-v3 card of one side whose game text names a pool-v3 card of the other side: its title
(bullets and "(V)" stripped) or one of its personas, as a whole word, case-sensitive (the name pattern of combo_map.py
rule v2: not followed by "'s" or by another capitalised word, not inside / right after an [icon] bracket). Unlike the
combo map, "cancel ...", "Immune to ...", "may not ..." and "opponent's ..." clauses count: they are how a card answers
an opponent's card. Pairs of two cards with the same title are skipped. Directed; the network links a card token to
the other side's card tokens in play only.
Rule v2 (after the first 50-pair check, 33/50 real): location targets are skipped (their names are place names:
"deploys only on Tatooine" is about the planet, not the opponent's system card); a name preceded by "your " (the own
copy) or by a capitalised word (part of a longer title, "Heart Of The Chasm") does not count; every occurrence is tried.
